QF.id: AIFM CIII Legal Documents and Negotiations_40

question.text: Per the Investor Charter's 'Responsibilities of Investors' section, an investor in Sahyadri Stat-Arb Fund is responsible for all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Thoroughly reading the PPM, Contribution Agreement and sales literature before investing.
Timely updating KYC information with the intermediary.
Guaranteeing the fund's absolute returns to co-investors via a personal indemnity.
Maintaining confidentiality of material non-public information received as an investor.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9 Annexure 9.1 Section F lists investor responsibilities: inform/educate self, update KYC, abide by Contribution Agreement, use right financial intermediaries, maintain confidentiality. An investor personally guaranteeing fund returns is NOT a charter responsibility and would conflict with 'investment terms are not guarantee of future performance.' The Trap: A, B, D are verbatim. Option C sounds aggressively investor-accountable but inverts the 'no return guarantee' principle of fund investing. Note: Pages 248-249 of the workbook contain the Investor Charter responsibilities and the no-guarantee-of-future-performance statement.
